_comment: Golden table for the canonical JSON every contract digest is taken over: keys sorted,
no whitespace, UTF-8, and non-ASCII text written as itself rather than as \u escapes.
TypeScript (canonicalEgressPolicyJson, canonicalAclPolicyJson), the broker's serde_json and
the provision wire already write it that way; Python's json.dumps escapes non-ASCII unless
ensure_ascii=False, which made the same value hash differently there. Read by
and the broker's tests. Keys are ASCII, as every contract key is, so ordering by UTF-16 code unit
and by code point agree. Lone surrogates are not text and are left out.
